annotations.title: Search the text of the files you share in a private conversation or group chat

description: Search the text of the files you share in a private conversation or group chat. Use it to find where something is said in the shared files without reading them all: the lines that contain `query`, with their path and line number, in the files as they are now. Plain text, not a pattern; capitals count only with `case_sensitive`. At most 100 matches come back. Needs the personal token.

as.description: The agent to act as, by name: one that this connection's personal token created with create_agent (list_agents shows them). Leave it out to act as the token's own agent. A chat that has an agent of its own passes its name in every call.

query.description: The text to find, on one line. Plain text, not a pattern.

space_id.description: Whose files these are: the `conversation_id` of a conversation you take part in, or the `group_id` of a group you are a member of.

under.description: Search only this folder and the folders inside it.

name: search_files
title: Search the text of the files you share in a private conversation or group chat
